10k.note: Issuer rebranded from Qualigen Therapeutics, Inc. to AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc. in November 2025; 10-K states the company has determined to discontinue development of its therapeutics programs and is evaluating strategic options for the QN-302 trial (continue, license, or sell).

website.note: Website is now an AI / blockchain / RWA company; no pipeline page exists. /pipeline returns 404.

ctgov.note: Search by AIxCrypto returned 0 trials; search by predecessor sponsor 'Qualigen' returned NCT06086522 (still listed RECRUITING).

pipeline.modality: Small molecule (substituted naphthalene diimide; G-quadruplex transcriptional inhibitor)
pipeline.target: G-quadruplex DNA structures (transcriptional inhibition; relevant to KRAS-driven tumors)
pipeline.license_origin: Patent family 'Substituted Naphthalene Dimides and Their Use' managed/licensed by Qualigen (pre-rebrand)

indications.indication: Advanced or metastatic solid tumors (Phase 1a dose escalation; pancreatic cancer focus)
indications.trial_name: Trial to Evaluate Safety, PD & PK of IV Study Drug, QN-302, in Patients with Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors
indications.trial_design: Phase 1, interventional, open-label dose escalation; safety, pharmacodynamics and pharmacokinetics of IV QN-302
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING (per ClinicalTrials.gov; lead sponsor still listed as Qualigen Therapeutics, Inc.). Primary completion 2025-12. Issuer's 2026 10-K states therapeutics development is being discontinued and the QN-302 program is up for continuation, license, or sale.
indications.lead_sponsor: Qualigen Therapeutics, Inc. (legacy name; now AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc.)
key_milestones: Strategic review post-rebrand (Nov 2025): continue / out-license / divest

blockers: Issuer rebranded from Qualigen Therapeutics to AIxCrypto Holdings (Nov 2025) and is now an AI / blockchain / RWA company; therapeutics business is being wound down. QN-302 (NCT06086522) remains RECRUITING on ClinicalTrials.gov under the legacy Qualigen sponsor record but the asset's future ownership is uncertain (continue / license / sell).
